title: CSV to Anki — convert a CSV or spreadsheet to an Anki deck
description: Paste CSV, tab-separated or semicolon-separated cards and download an Anki deck (.apkg). Quotes, tags and math are handled. Free, runs in your browser.
h1: CSV to Anki without the import settings
sub: Paste rows from a CSV file, a spreadsheet or an AI answer. The separator is detected, quoted text is kept intact and you get a ready-to-open .apkg file.

paragraphs: Each row becomes a card: the first column is the front, the second the back. Commas, tabs, semicolons, vertical bars and "::" are recognised. Text in double quotes can contain the separator itself.

If the first row is a header such as Front, Back, Tags, it is skipped, and a Tags column is used as Anki tags. Rows copied straight from Excel, Google Sheets or Numbers arrive tab-separated, which works as is.

list: Use a third column for tags, separated by spaces.
Put a line break inside a cell by quoting the cell.
Check the preview: remove any row you don't want before downloading.
